I had my own Wonderhell moment shortly after my last book came out.
I'd spent the previous few weeks existing on airplanes.

At the moment of this realization, I was 35,000 feet in the air; I had 1,200 miles behind me and 1,200 more to go.

Wonderhell teaches us that success is not a final destination at all, but merely an inflection point along the way.
